name: Gradient Theorem Violation Metric
definition: A quantitative error metric that evaluates gradient approximations by measuring how much the gradient theorem is violated, avoiding the flaws of L1/L2 norms (which are sensitive to distribution shape limits) and finite difference errors.
summary: The Gradient Theorem Violation Metric evaluates gradient accuracy by measuring the L1 difference between a gradient field's line integral and the function value difference at curve endpoints, avoiding the need for reference gradients.
